<thought>Using the metadata, I have the paths to the training and test CSV files. I will now train the XGBoost regression model with the provided hyperparameters and save it as trained_xgboost_model.pkl in the designated output directory.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
  "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_1/oxide_ml_dataset/train.csv",
  "test_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_1/oxide_ml_dataset/test.csv",
  "model_save_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_1/trained_xgboost_model.pkl",
  "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
  "hyperparameters": {
    "n_estimators": 200,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1
  }
}</action_input>
